name: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy
description: Overuse injury from repetitive overhead pressing, leading to inflammation of the rotator cuff tendons.

name: Rotator Cuff Tear
description: Partial or complete tear of the rotator cuff, often from heavy pressing or sudden explosive movements.

name: Glenohumeral Instability
description: Loose shoulder joint, causing excessive movement and a risk of subluxation or dislocation.

name: Acromioclavicular (AC) Joint Sprain
description: Injury to the AC joint, often from a direct fall or impact on the point of the shoulder.

name: Pectoralis Major Strain
description: Overstretching or tearing of the pectoral muscle, common during heavy bench pressing.

name: Pectoralis Major Rupture
description: Complete tear of the pectoral tendon from the bone, a serious injury occurring during maximal eccentric loading.

name: Costochondritis
description: Inflammation of the cartilage connecting a rib to the breastbone (sternum), causing chest wall pain.

name: Sternoclavicular (SC) Joint Sprain
description: Sprain of the joint between the breastbone and collarbone, often from a direct blow.

name: Lower Back Muscle Strain
description: Stretching or tearing of muscles in the lower back, common in deadlifts and bent-over rows.

name: Lumbar Disc Herniation
description: The soft center of a spinal disc leaks through a tear in the outer layer, potentially pressing on nerves.

name: Spondylolysis
description: Stress fracture of the vertebra, often from repeated hyperextension (e.g., in deadlifts or squats).

name: Latissimus Dorsi Strain
description: Strain of the large back muscle, often felt during pull-ups, rows, or deadlifts.

name: Patellar Tendinopathy
description: Overuse injury causing pain in the patellar tendon, common from jumping and squatting ('Jumper's Knee').

name: Patellar Tendon Tear
description: Complete rupture of the patellar tendon, requiring surgical intervention.

name: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Sprain
description: Injury to the ACL, often a non-contact injury from sudden stopping or direction change.

name: Medial Collateral Ligament (MCL) Sprain
description: Sprain of the inner knee ligament, often from a direct blow to the outer knee.

name: Meniscal Tear
description: Tear in the knee cartilage, often from twisting the knee under load (e.g., in a squat).

name: Quadriceps Strain
description: Strain of the quadriceps muscle from sprinting, jumping, or squatting.

name: Hamstrings Strain
description: Strain of the hamstring muscle, common in running, jumping, and Romanian deadlifts.

name: Hamstrings Tear
description: Complete tear of the hamstring muscle or tendon, a severe injury with significant bruising.

name: Groin Strain
description: Strain of the inner thigh muscles (adductors), common in lateral movements and sumo squats.

name: Plantar Fasciitis
description: Inflammation of the thick tissue on the bottom of the foot, causing heel pain.

name: Achilles Tendinopathy
description: Overuse injury causing pain and stiffness in the Achilles tendon, common in runners.

name: Achilles Tendon Rupture
description: Complete tear of the Achilles tendon, a sudden and serious injury.

name: Shin Splints
description: Pain along the shin bone, common from high-impact running or jumping.

name: Tibial Stress Fracture
description: A small crack in the shinbone, from repetitive, high-impact load (a 'bone strain').

name: Ankle Sprain
description: Stretching or tearing of ankle ligaments, often from rolling the ankle.

name: Biceps Brachii Strain
description: Strain of the biceps muscle, common during heavy curling motions.

name: Distal Biceps Tendon Rupture
description: Rupture of the biceps tendon at the elbow, a sudden injury from an unexpected load.

name: Triceps Tendon Strain
description: Overstretching of the triceps tendon, from heavy pressing or extension movements.

name: Triceps Tendon Rupture
description: Complete tear of the triceps tendon, a rare but serious injury.

name: Medial Epicondylitis
description: Inflammation where the forearm flexor tendons attach to the inner elbow, 'Golfer's Elbow'.

name: Lateral Epicondylitis
description: Inflammation where the forearm extensor tendons attach to the outer elbow, 'Tennis Elbow'.

name: Wrist Sprain
description: Stretching or tearing of wrist ligaments, often from a fall on an outstretched hand.

name: Rectus Abdominis Strain
description: Strain of the 'six-pack' muscles, common during heavy sit-ups or leg raises.

name: Oblique Strain
description: Strain of the side abdominal muscles, often from twisting movements.

name: Hernia
description: An organ pushes through a weak spot in the abdominal wall, aggravated by heavy lifting.

name: Neck Muscle Strain
description: Stretching or tearing of the neck's muscles, often from poor posture during heavy lifts.

name: Cervical Radiculopathy
description: Pinched nerve in the neck that can cause pain, numbness, or weakness radiating into the arm.
